title: Business Requirements Document
coverNote: Vision, market, customers, business model, pricing, go-to-market, KPIs, 5-year roadmap, financial plan and risks.
howToRead: This BRD explains the business side of EduFlow in easy language: the problem, the market, the customers, how EduFlow earns money, how it will be sold, and the plan for the next five years.

Read Part I first. If you are short on time, read the "In simple words" line at the top and the "Key takeaways" list at the end of every chapter. Tables hold the exact numbers; every number that is a target or an estimate is labelled so.
Requirement IDs such as BR-014 in this document link to the modules described in the PRD.

parts.title: Part I — Vision and Opportunity
parts.blurb: What EduFlow is, the problem it solves, and what the business wants to achieve.

parts.title: Part II — Market and Competition
parts.blurb: How big the market is in India and abroad, who else sells to it, and where EduFlow can win.

parts.title: Part III — Customers
parts.blurb: The people who buy and use EduFlow: their goals, frustrations, daily work and buying process.

parts.title: Part IV — Business Model and Growth
parts.blurb: How EduFlow makes money, what it charges, how it finds customers and how it keeps them.

parts.title: Part V — Requirements and Measurement
parts.blurb: What the business needs from the product, the rules it must follow, and the numbers that show progress.

parts.title: Part VI — The Five-Year Plan
parts.blurb: Roadmap, team, money and risks from Year 1 to Year 5.
